purpose: Teach: プロット/譜面/増刊/アセスメント/書き下ろし/個人向け/抵当/約定

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新ストーリーのプロットを練りましょう
lines.en: Let's work on developing the plot for the new story.
lines.style: Brisk, purposeful opening. Clear directive tone. Forward momentum. Expecting immediate engagement and agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様向けに譜面を配付する案件を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with the plan to distribute the score materials to our clients.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment with quiet confidence. Measured pace. The tone of someone already in motion, updating without needing praise.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内報の特別増刊号を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's put out a special expanded edition of the company newsletter.
lines.style: Clear directive with gentle enthusiasm. Slight lift on the key idea. Assuming buy-in without demanding it. Collaborative, not commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの事前アセスメントを実施しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently carrying out the pre-project assessment.
lines.style: Status update delivered steadily. No urgency, no hesitation. The tone of reliable progress being made. Straightforward, courteous.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様のために書き下ろしの記事を依頼しましょう
lines.en: Let's ask the VIP client to commission an original article for us.
lines.style: Directive framed as collaborative. Slight emphasis on 'original' and 'VIP'—showing thought. Warm confidence in the ask. Moving the conversation forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。個人向けの会員プランを企画しました
lines.en: Yes. I've put together a membership plan for individual clients.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. The tone of work completed and ready. Calm, factual. Not seeking praise, but opening space for response.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの土地の抵当解除を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with releasing the mortgage on the office property.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike directive. Decisive tone without harshness. The voice of someone managing administrative matters competently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様と新約定書を交換しました
lines.en: Yes. I've completed the exchange of the new agreement with our VIP client.
lines.style: Closing statement delivered with calm finality. Steady pace, grounded tone. The sense of a task well done, ready to move to the next phase.
